about: WWE 2K14 (Xbox 360) arena ids: the value the menus pass to the arena setter sub_822C9748 (M+532, then G+64), and the arena archive pac\bg\BGnn.PAC it loads (nn = the id, two digits). Session 9, 2026-10-10. 'confirmed' = the menu value and the archive opened at match load were both seen in a run; 'id_list' = the arena id list Jarrod found (names); 'icon_table' = Session 8's static reading of the arena icon table at 0x8203F998 (docs/systems/match_setup.md) only. 300 is not an arena: it means 'the match type's default arena'.

evidence_key.capture: a capture's arena (M+532) for an arena Jarrod picked (run 486) or the scripted route picked
evidence_key.bg_load: BGnn.PAC opened at match load with that value in G+64
evidence_key.icon_table: Session 8: arena icon table {BG id, icon name, x} at 0x8203F998, names read from the icon names (static, not seen in a run)
evidence_key.grid: position on the arena select grid (Jarrod's screenshot, 2026-10-10; ARENAS tab)
evidence_key.id_list: Smacktalks thread "WWE 2K14 complete CH and BG pac list", https://smacktalks.org/forums/topic/44532-wwe-2k14-complete-ch-and-bg-pac-list/ : the BG list as pasted by Jarrod (2026-10-10; the page refuses automated fetches, so not read by us). Agrees with every arena id confirmed in our runs (0, 4, 6, 9, 21, 22, 56), and the dump holds exactly the bgNN.pac set it lists

menu_grid.tab: ARENAS (first of the LB / RB tabs; the WrestleMania arenas are another tab, locked on the frozen save)
menu_grid.note: Rows are 5 / 4 / 4 / 5 wide and the cursor wraps: UP from RAW lands on Hell in a Cell, UP UP on Over the Limit (Session 6 cursor facts). The grid opens on a random pre-selected arena: reset the cursor first (RB x3 -> RAW, Session 6).
